duplicates.basis: A trip is listed when another source of this cohort publishes the same departure: at least 90% of its located calls (and at least two) are matched in order by one trip of the other source, at a stop in the same or a neighbouring cell of about 280 m and within 60 seconds in UTC; a match of fewer than 9 calls counts only when the line labels agree (the same words, a shared word containing a digit, or the same digit strings). The trip with more calls is shown; on equal calls the one with a publisher road path, then the source that runs more of that line in the cohort, then the source listed first in the bus registry. A date is removed only where the shown trip runs that date. Frequency-based trips are never removed.
